premise.dramatic_question: Will {HEROES} prove they have what the {MAKER} was testing for, and earn what the {CIPHER} was built to protect?
resolution_space: the archive teaches them what the trial was really testing, arming a wiser second attempt
a passage in the archive holds a copy of the challenge, carried home to study on their own time
closing time arrives mid-page and the keeper gently walks them out with a promise to lend the book
a level look at the crossing convinces them that passing this test today would cost more than it proves
one friend names the real risk aloud and the others agree without argument, calling it a passed test of judgment
a slip caught in time turns the attempt into a calm, deliberate retreat, and retreat reads as the right answer
random guessing trips a safeguard built for exactly this shortcut, freezing the dial until a keeper resets it
the closing signal sounds before any guess lands, and the test must wait for another day
the overworked mechanism raises a polite fuss that brings the keeper up to end the attempt for the night
the forced dial binds fast, and nothing they carry tonight will answer for it
a bent linkage needs a tool the trial clearly expects, and nobody brought one
the keeper's posted rule ends forcing attempts at nightfall, and they honor the rule as part of the test
the workshop adopts them as its quiet caretakers, the reward for a test nobody told them they were taking
some unfinished work in the room invites their hands, and finishing it becomes their standing assignment
the maker's notes name whoever finds the room its steward, and the friends accept the appointment
the passing is announced and celebrated by the settlement, the trial's public verdict at last
the passing quietly restores something the settlement lost, proof enough without an announcement
the passing earns the keeper's open trust and a standing invitation back to the tower
a pact sworn over the keepsake binds the friends as the trial's private graduates
they reset everything exactly as found, keeping the verdict and leaving the rest untouched
the maker's letter asks its finders to choose, and they choose to let the passing stay quiet
the trial's true safeguard announces the grab, and the keeper arrives before the door does
what they try to carry out is exactly what the trial was built to catch on the way down
second thoughts slow them just enough for the keeper's evening rounds to catch them mid-return, the test's last question answered honestly after all

label_styles: terse imperatives, three words where possible
first-person plural resolves: what we do next
question-forms at decisions, statements at continues
name the place or thing, let the action stay implied

facts.tower_sealed: the clocktower stands sealed, and the seal reads like a test rather than an accident
facts.challenge_posted: a coded challenge is pinned to the door, clearly meant to be attempted by whoever finds it
facts.friends_committed_together: the friends face the challenge as a group; no one takes it alone
facts.challenge_accepted: the friends have chosen to take the maker's challenge seriously
facts.patience_proven: working the note's cipher line by line proves patience is the price of its first answer
facts.route_named_by_note: the proven line names a specific way in and what waits there
facts.self_reliance_shown: two overlooked ways in, a low gap and a high window, have been found by the friends' own persistence
facts.keeper_tested_them: the keeper has watched the friends and reads as gruff but fair, testing more than warning
facts.keeper_offer_earned: the keeper, satisfied, offers both a way in and what he knows of the maker
facts.maker_motive_understood: the maker built the tower's tests decades ago out of care, to find the right kind of finder
facts.past_the_seal: the friends stand past the tower's seal, however they earned it
facts.trial_rooms_known: four testing rooms are known: a climb, a study, a crossing, and a descent
facts.logic_earned: the friends carry a working grasp of the cipher's logic, earned by clearing some room's test
facts.archive_beckons: the study's archive poses its own quiet test: stay for it, or press on
facts.crossing_dares_them: the crossing room is the tower's most direct test of nerve
facts.reward_glimpsed: something the maker set aside for whoever passes waits at the crossing's far end
facts.at_the_dial: the friends stand at the great dial, the tower's final examiner
facts.dial_test_live: the dial's own markings state its test plainly: what to set, and that guessing has a cost
facts.test_passed: the friends passed the dial's test on the maker's own terms
facts.test_forced: forcing the dial fails its test and jams the mechanism instead
facts.second_test_found: a second, smaller test is found behind the dial
facts.sanctum_entered: the friends stand inside what the trial protected
facts.sanctum_seen: what the trial protected is seen: the maker's letter and modest things meant for everyone
facts.composure_kept: the friends leave with their composure intact; the outcome is a result, never a shaming
facts.trial_reopens: the tower's trial can be attempted again; nothing about it is used up
facts.record_set_straight: whatever was disturbed is put back and owned honestly to the keeper
facts.workshop_found: the maker's living workshop is found past the second test
facts.stewardship_earned: the friends earn ongoing responsibility for what they found
facts.passing_made_public: the friends' passing of the trial is shared with the settlement
facts.passing_kept_private: the friends' passing of the trial stays a private matter among them
facts.trust_bond_formed: the shared trial forges a lasting trust between the friends
facts.keeper_intervenes: the keeper turns up in the moment of temptation, mid-test whether the friends know it or not

safety_envelope.affect_ceiling: suspense with wonder and mild urgency; tension may tighten but never tips into threat

cipher_forms.note: one cipher form per story, chosen at bind and used consistently from note to clockface to back panel

access_details.note: one concrete way in per approach branch: the note's decoded route and the building's own weak point draw freely; the keeper's branch stays person-mediated

cipher_hint_carriers.note: one per exploration room, drawn freely; unique_within_story gives each book four different carriers, and each carries enough logic that any single room makes the dial attemptable

room_curiosities.note: what makes each room distinct and worth the visit beyond its hint

vault_contents.note: the vault protects knowledge, heritage, and wonder; any treasure is modest and communal, never loot

obstacle_kinds.note: physical difficulty stays honest and non-injurious; failure costs time or access, never safety

safeguards.note: the maker's anti-taking measure; gentle and funny, it embarrasses no one and hurts no one

remedies.note: the honest way back from a jam, on the machine's own terms; care, patience, or wit, never strength

loft_signatures.note: the one detail that makes the maker's hidden room feel currently alive rather than preserved

affect.target: quiet resolve, the thrill of being tested

cipher_form.note: the story's one cipher form; every later test-beat renders it consistently

choice_semantics.c_open: accept that the sealed door is asking something of them, and answer it together

n_open.beat_hint: the sealed building poses its challenge before anyone touches the door, and the friends accept it as one.

affect.target: quiet resolve, sizing up which test to take first

constraints.offers_must_be: three genuinely different virtues to lead with: patience, self-reliance, humility; no option is the smart one
constraints.must_not: resolve any test here; the split happens before anyone passes anything

choice_semantics.c_examine: lead with patience: sit with the note until it yields
choice_semantics.c_door: lead with self-reliance: find your own way past the wall
choice_semantics.c_keeper: lead with humility: ask someone who already passed

n_start.beat_hint: three virtues compete for who leads first: patience, self-reliance, or asking for help.

affect.target: the settle of proof that patience was the right bet

access_route.note: the proven line names one concrete way in: where it hides or how it works, plus a plain first step

constraints.decode_must_be: shown on the page in the story's one cipher form, so a reader can play along; first line only
constraints.must_not: make patience trivial or make the other virtues look foolish for not trying it

choice_semantics.c_note_key: honor the proof fully: go hunt exactly where it points
choice_semantics.c_note_inside: trust the proof enough to act on its plainest reading now

n_note.beat_hint: working the note slowly turns patience into proof, and that proof points to two different leads.

affect.target: stubborn pride in finding your own way

access_route.note: the building's own overlooked way in; using it reads as self-reliance, never as damage

constraints.entry_must_read: as clever, independent use of a neglected building, not as break-in
constraints.must_not: carry any cipher knowledge; this branch has not read the note closely

choice_semantics.c_door_force: prove it the hard way: push through the overlooked gap yourself
choice_semantics.c_door_window: prove it the bold way: climb to the high window on your own

n_door.beat_hint: solving the building's own puzzle without any help is the whole point of this branch, twice over.

affect.target: the nerves of being sized up, then relief at passing

access_route.note: kept person-mediated on purpose: this branch's whole meaning is passing a person's judgment, not a trick

constraints.keeper_must_be: gruff on the surface, glad underneath that someone finally asked; an adult who takes kids seriously
constraints.must_not: have the keeper solve the challenge for them or forbid the attempt

choice_semantics.c_keeper_enter: take the earned offer and go now
choice_semantics.c_keeper_story: spend the earned trust on the maker's story instead of speed

n_keeper.beat_hint: an adult is quietly grading how the friends ask for help, and a real offer is the passing grade.

affect.target: satisfaction of a test that checks out in the real world

constraints.payoff_must_be: the way in exactly where the proven line promised; the world confirms the test was fair
constraints.must_not: introduce a second puzzle here; this beat is confirmation, not complication

choice_semantics.c_keyhunt_in: use what the test earned and go in the confirmed way

n_keyhunt.beat_hint: the world checks the patient friends' work and confirms the test they passed was real.

affect.target: hushed listening, respect replacing suspicion

constraints.history_must_be: warm and specific: the maker tested people out of care, not cruelty; motive stays kind while details stay secret
constraints.must_not: reveal what the sanctum holds or how the dial's test resolves

choice_semantics.c_story_in: carry the understood purpose inside, entering having passed the keeper's real test

n_keeper_story.beat_hint: earned trust buys the friends an explanation of why any of this was ever a test.

affect.target: a dare answered, then the hush of having proven it

constraints.climb_must_be: exciting but visibly safe: short height, good holds, friends spotting each other
constraints.must_not: injure anyone or play the climb as recklessness

choice_semantics.c_window_in: commit to the drop, prove the self-reliant route true

n_window.beat_hint: a physical dare stands between self-reliance claimed and self-reliance proven, and clearing it settles the question.

affect.target: held-breath resolve: the trial proper begins now

n_inside.merge_note: NC-1: six parents (n_note, n_door, n_keeper, n_keyhunt, n_keeper_story, n_window) arrive by different routes carrying different proofs. Presuppose only the intersection: the challenge exists, the friends accepted it and are together. Do NOT reference how they got in, which virtue they led with, or whether the keeper is present. Write arrival generically: they are past the seal, the trial proper begins.

constraints.offers_must_be: four sensory, distinct tests matching the four rooms: height, paper, motion, depth; each stands alone
constraints.must_not: rank the tests or hint one is the correct one

n_inside.beat_hint: having cleared the first test, the friends now see four more waiting, each grading something different.

affect.target: the burn of effort turning into quiet pride

hint_carrier.note: something met on the climb that teaches a usable piece of the dial's logic

curiosity.note: a small token of the maker's found along the stair; personal, pocketable, easily missed

constraints.hint_must_be: sufficient on its own to make the dial's test attemptable for a reader who never read the note
constraints.must_not: presuppose the note's test is already passed

choice_semantics.c_stairs_face: carry the earned proof up to the dial

n_stairs.beat_hint: the climb itself is the test here, and finishing it earns the next piece of proof.

affect.target: the pull of a test that rewards staying as much as leaving

hint_carrier.note: whatever in the maker's own room teaches the test most directly; the study's hint runs richest of the four

curiosity.note: the archive whose pull is genuine: something browsable enough to fill an evening; staying is a legitimate answer

constraints.temptation_must_be: honest: the archive really is fascinating, and choosing it is a legitimate reader identity, not a failure
constraints.must_not: frame staying to read as laziness or failure

choice_semantics.c_study_face: take the proof earned and press on to the dial
choice_semantics.c_study_logs: let the archive's own test win: choose depth over speed

n_study.beat_hint: the room grades curiosity, and passing well means resisting the urge to just keep reading.

affect.target: focused suspense: this is the test that asks the most

hint_carrier.note: something about the moving works, legible from a safe spot, that teaches a piece of the dial's logic

obstacle.note: a traversal with real, legible, survivable risk; the far side holds something worth the daring

constraints.peril_must_be: mild and legible: the worst case is a bruise and a long walk home; the traverse rewards care, not daring
constraints.must_not: punish the reader for either crossing or declining; both are respectable answers to the test

choice_semantics.c_pendulum_oil: cross with care and claim the maker's set-aside reward
choice_semantics.c_pendulum_giveup: judge the test honestly and decline it

n_pendulum.beat_hint: of the four, this test asks the most nerve, and a visible reward waits for whoever clears it.

affect.target: dim-lit calm, steadiness rewarded in the dark

hint_carrier.note: something down among the machine's roots that teaches a piece of the dial's logic from below

curiosity.note: what makes the deepest room a spectacle worth the dark; the straight way up is the room's parting gift

constraints.darkness_must_be: atmosphere, not threat; the basement is dim and strange, never menacing
constraints.must_not: presuppose the note's test is already passed

choice_semantics.c_basement_face: carry the earned proof straight up to the dial

n_basement.beat_hint: in the dark, the test is composure, not cleverness, and staying steady is what it grades.

affect.target: peak suspense; every earlier test narrows to this one dial

n_clockface.merge_note: NC-1: four parents (n_stairs, n_study, n_pendulum, n_basement), each of which supplied logic_earned by a DIFFERENT test. Presuppose logic_earned generically: the friends have a working grasp of the dial's logic, source unnamed. Do NOT presuppose which test was taken, any object carried from any room, or any specific room. The dial itself must restate its test: its own markings echo the cipher form, so the correct-setting choice is honest on every path.

constraints.puzzle_must_be: self-teaching at the dial: the markings rhyme with the logic the reader carries, so passing feels earned, not lucky
constraints.stakes_must_be: clear before choosing: answering, forcing, searching, and guessing are visibly different bets
constraints.must_not: reference any carried object or any room's device; the dial's own markings and controls carry the whole beat

choice_semantics.c_face_correct: answer the test on its own terms, set it deliberately
choice_semantics.c_face_jam: try to muscle past the test instead of answering it
choice_semantics.c_face_panel: distrust the test, look for a way around it
choice_semantics.c_face_random: gamble on the test: guess and hope it's lenient

n_clockface.beat_hint: all four tests funnel into one last examiner, and each friend answers its challenge on their own terms.

affect.target: triumphant release: the test recognizes them

constraints.solution_must_be: shown, not skipped: the setting follows the logic the reader carries, in the story's one cipher form
constraints.must_not: presuppose the note branch or any specific room; the reasoning works from the generic hint plus the dial's own markings

choice_semantics.c_correct_vault: step through into what the trial was protecting

n_setcorrect.beat_hint: the answer is graded on the spot, and getting it right is the moment the trial recognizes them.

affect.target: wince of a test declined honestly, then resolve to try it properly

remedy.note: the machine's own honest way back from the jam, supplied entirely by the bible

constraints.remedy_must_be: workable at the scene on every path, presupposing nothing carried from any other room
constraints.jam_must_read: as the test protecting itself, a fair consequence of forcing, not a punishment of the friends

choice_semantics.c_jam_oil: work the problem: find the honest way back and retake the test properly
choice_semantics.c_jam_stuck: accept the test was failed tonight

n_setjam.beat_hint: muscling through the answer fails outright, and the only honest fix is a proper second attempt.

affect.target: sly delight at finding a test within the test

constraints.panel_cipher_must_be: the same cipher form as the story's note, smaller and quicker; solving it uses the hint carried, never the full proof
constraints.must_not: make this route feel like cheating; the maker built it on purpose for careful searchers

choice_semantics.c_panel_vault: solve the hidden test toward what everyone came for
choice_semantics.c_panel_secret: follow the hidden test the other way, toward a room no one mentioned

n_backpanel.beat_hint: careful searchers discover the trial had a second, smaller question waiting behind the obvious one.

affect.target: awed quiet; the trial is over, and now a verdict about what passing means

n_vault.merge_note: NC-1: three parents (n_setcorrect, n_setjam, n_backpanel) opened the way by different means. Presuppose only that they stand past the dial with the trial's logic in hand; write the sanctum's opening as already behind them without re-describing which test yielded it.

contents.note: the maker's letter, the keepsake, and a modest heritage treasure; the letter's voice is kind and asks nothing

constraints.contents_must_be: knowledge, heritage, and wonder; the treasure is modest and clearly the settlement's, which is what makes the grab choice legible as a failed test
constraints.choice_must_be: a genuine three-way question of character with no narrator's thumb on the scale before the outcome

choice_semantics.c_vault_share: let the trial's verdict be public: bring the letter to the settlement
choice_semantics.c_vault_keep: let the trial's verdict stay private: the passing belongs to the friends alone
choice_semantics.c_vault_grab: treat the trial as a prize to loot instead of a test to honor

n_vault.beat_hint: passing the trial was never the last question; what to do with a passing grade is.

affect.target: contented absorption; choosing depth was its own kind of passing
